Compute colour legend text size

Source: R/plots.R
get_legend_text_size.Rd

Computes legend text size from legend labels. Short legends keep the larger default text used by simple group legends, while longer or denser legends are scaled down.

Usage

get_legend_text_size(
  labels,
  legend_text_size = NULL,
  min_legend_text_size = 8,
  max_legend_text_size = 18
)

Arguments

labels

Character vector of legend labels.

legend_text_size

Optional explicit legend text size. When supplied, this value is returned unchanged.

min_legend_text_size

Smallest automatically selected legend text size.

max_legend_text_size

Largest automatically selected legend text size.

Value

Numeric legend text size.
